####### Catch Data: Explore STATLANT 21A Database

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)

#### Catch Data: explore the NAFO Statlant 21A Data

stat <- read.csv("Ess_data/NAFO-21A-Full.csv")
# take a look 
head(stat)
# Filter to 4VS and 4W divisions
stat <- filter(stat, Division == "4VS" | Division == "4W")
unique(stat$Species.Name)
unique(stat$Division)

# Quick check to explore species in catch
stat_grouped_all <- stat |>
  rename(V = Year) |>
  group_by(V, Species.Name) |>
  summarise(catch_g = sum(Metric.Tonnes) * 1e6, .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(V >= 1970, V <= 2024) |>
  group_by(Species.Name) |>
  summarise(prop_catch = mean(catch_g), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(prop_catch = prop_catch / sum(prop_catch) * 100) |>
  arrange(desc(prop_catch))

data_plot <- stat_grouped_all |>
  mutate(Species.Name = reorder(Species.Name, prop_catch))

# Barplot
ggplot(data_plot, aes(x = Species.Name, y = prop_catch)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip()

# top species in prop_catch (ignore squid)
stat_grouped_all[1:15, ]

# species to extract data for:
# [1] "AMERICAN PLAICE"         
# [2] "COD(ATLANTIC)"  
# [3]"ATLANTIC HERRING"
# [4] "HADDOCK"                 
# [5] "REDFISH UNSEPARATED"     
# [6] "SPINY DOGFISH"           
# [7] "TURBOT,GREENLAND HALIBUT"
# [8] "WITCH FLOUNDER"          
# [9] "YELLOWTAIL FLOUNDER"
# [10] "WHITE HAKE"
# [11] "SILVER HAKE"       
# [12] "SANDLANCES"       
# [13] "ATLANTIC HALIBUT"       


nafo_names <- c(
  "AMERICAN PLAICE - PLA",
  "ATLANTIC COD - COD",
  "ATLANTIC HERRING - HER",
  "ATLANTIC HALIBUT - HAL",
  "ATLANTIC MACKEREL - MAC",      # ← ADD
  "ATLANTIC REDFISHES (NS) - RED",
  "CAPELIN - CAP",                 # ← ADD
  #"GREENLAND HALIBUT - GHL", # remove
  "POLLOCK (SAITHE) - POK", # ADD
  "HADDOCK - HAD",
  "SANDEELS (SANDLANCES) - SAN",
  "SILVER HAKE - HKS",
  "SPINY (=PICKED) DOGFISH - DGS",
  "WHITE HAKE - HKW",
  "WITCH FLOUNDER - WIT",
  "YELLOWTAIL FLOUNDER - YEL"
)


# Return to orginal data to subet species in model
stat<-subset(stat,Species.Name %in% nafo_names)

# rename 
stat$Species<-as.factor(stat$Species.Name)
levels(stat$Species)
#CAREFUL: THE BELOW NAMES NEED TO BE MATCHED TO THE CORRECT SPECIES NAMES

levels(stat$Species) <- c(
  "AMERICAN PLAICE",
  "ATLANTIC COD",
  "ATLANTIC HALIBUT",
  "ATLANTIC HERRING",
  "ATLANTIC MACKEREL",
  "ATLANTIC REDFISHES",
  "CAPELIN",
  "HADDOCK",
  "POLLOCK",
  "SANDLANCES",
  "SILVER HAKE",
  "SPINY DOGFISH",
  "WHITE HAKE",
  "WITCH FLOUNDER",
  "YELLOWTAIL FLOUNDER"
)

### Aggreagte over whole Division 4VW and convert to GRAMS WET WEIGHT

stat_grouped<-stat%>% rename(Year = V) %>%
  group_by(Year,Species) %>%
  reframe(catch_g = sum(Metric.Tonnes)*1e6)

#### check plots

names(stat_grouped)<-c("Year","Species","Catches_g_per_yr")
ggplot(stat_grouped,aes(x=Year,y=Catches_g_per_yr,group=Species)) + geom_line() + facet_wrap(~Species,scales="free_y") 


ggplot(stat_grouped,aes(x=Year,y=Catches_g_per_yr,fill=Species)) + geom_area() 


ggplot(filter(stat_grouped,Year >= 1978), 
       aes(x = Year, y = Catches_g_per_yr, fill = Species)) + 
  geom_area() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1992.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "NAFO 4VW Total Catch by Species (1978-2024)",
    subtitle = "Red dashed line = moratorium (1992)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Catch (grams/year)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

saveRDS(stat_grouped, file = "Ess_data/NAFO_4VW_Catches.RDS")
#saveRDS(stat_grouped,"NAFO_4VW_Catches.RDS")


# Re-create catch_matrix_mizer with all 15 species in the same order as effort
catch_matrix_mizer <- stat_grouped |>
  filter(between(Year, 1978, 2024)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Species, values_from = Catches_g_per_yr, values_fill = 0) |>
  arrange(Year) |>
  column_to_rownames("Year") |>
  as.matrix()

# Ensure all 15 species are present (add SANDLANCES if missing)
catch_matrix_mizer <- cbind(catch_matrix_mizer, SANDLANCES = 0)

# Re-order to match effort_matrix_mizer_scaled exactly
catch_matrix_mizer <- catch_matrix_mizer[, c(
  "AMERICAN PLAICE", "ATLANTIC COD", "ATLANTIC HALIBUT", "ATLANTIC HERRING",
  "ATLANTIC MACKEREL", "ATLANTIC REDFISHES", "CAPELIN", "HADDOCK", "POLLOCK",
  "SANDLANCES", "SILVER HAKE", "SPINY DOGFISH", "WHITE HAKE", "WITCH FLOUNDER",
  "YELLOWTAIL FLOUNDER"
)]

# Standardize catches (0-1 scale)
catch_matrix_mizer_scaled <- catch_matrix_mizer |>
  apply(2, function(x) x / max(x, na.rm = TRUE))


```

```{r}
## get data
cols_old <- c("Year", "Country", "GearCode", "Tonnage", "MainSpecies", "Divcode", "Code", "Effort", 
              "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec")

              "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec")

## read in each file and rename columns to standard names

  select(all_of(cols_old)) |>

nafo70s <- read_delim("Ess_data/nafo-21b-70-79/NAFO21B-70-79.txt") |>
  select(all_of(cols_old)) |>
  rename(Gear = GearCode, AreaCode = Divcode, SpeciesEffort = Code)
nafo80s <- read_delim("Ess_data/nafo-21b-80-89/NAFO21B-80-89.txt") |>
  select(all_of(cols_old)) |>
  rename(Gear = GearCode, AreaCode = Divcode, SpeciesEffort = Code)
nafo90s <- read_delim("Ess_data/nafo-21b-90-99/NAFO21B-90-99.txt") |>
  select(all_of(cols_old)) |>
  rename(Gear = GearCode, AreaCode = Divcode, SpeciesEffort = Code)
nafo00s <- read_delim("Ess_data/nafo-21b-2000-09/NAFO21B-2000-09.txt") |>
  select(all_of(cols_old)) |>
  rename(Gear = GearCode, AreaCode = Divcode, SpeciesEffort = Code)
nafo10s <- read_delim("Ess_data/NAFO-21B-2010-19/NAFO-21B-2010-2019.txt") |>
  select(all_of(cols_new))
nafo20s <- read_delim("Ess_data/NAFO-21B-2020-24/NAFO-21B-2020-24.txt") |>
  select(all_of(cols_new))

## combine all datasets (without 2020-24)
nafo_21B <- bind_rows(nafo60s, nafo70s, nafo80s, nafo90s, nafo00s, nafo10s,nafo20s) |>
  filter(SpeciesEffort %in% c(1, 2, 3)) |>
  filter(AreaCode %in% c(45, 46)) #4VsW (see divisions.txt for codes)

## rename columns & combine & subset to effort data
# names(nafo60s)<-names(nafo70s)<-names(nafo80s)<-names(nafo90s)<-names(nafo00s)<-names(nafo10s)<-names(nafo20s)
# nafo_21B<-rbind(nafo60s,nafo70s,nafo80s,nafo90s,nafo00s,nafo10s,nafo20s)
# nafo_21B<-subset(nafo_21B,SpeciesEffort %in% c(1,2,3))
# # subset to 4VW
# nafo_21B<-subset(nafo_21B,AreaCode %in% c(44,45,46,48))

# subset to 4VW

nafo_21B$TotalEffort = rowSums(nafo_21B[,c("Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec")])
nafo_21B<-nafo_21B[,c("Year","Country", "Gear","Tonnage","MainSpecies", "AreaCode","SpeciesEffort", "Effort","TotalEffort")
]


# subset to effort data that is  SpeciesEffort code "2" Days Fished
nafo_21B_grouped_daysfished<-nafo_21B%>% subset(SpeciesEffort=="2")%>%
  group_by(Year,Gear,Tonnage,MainSpecies,SpeciesEffort) %>%
  reframe(TotalDaysFished = sum(TotalEffort))


### IGNORE THIS - only use if not doing species -specific effort but instead by gear type
### which Gear Codes to include? Trawls only?
# Bottom otter trawl (charters),8,OTB*
# Midwater trawl,9,OTM*
# Bottom otter trawl (side or stern not specified),10,OTB
# Bottom otter trawl (side),11,OTB-1
# Bottom otter trawl,12,OTB-2
# Midwater trawl (side or stern not specified),13,OTM
# Midwater trawl (side),14,OTM-1
# Midwater trawl (stern),15,OTM-2
# Bottom pair trawl (2 boats),16,PTB
# Midwater pair trawl (2 boats),17,PTM
# Beam trawl,18,TBB
# Otter shrimp twin trawl,19,OTS
# Otter twin trawl,192,OTT
# "Set gillnets",41,"GNS"
# "Drift gillnets",42,"GND"
#"Longlines (charters)",49,"LL*"
#"Longlines (not specified)",50,"LL"
 
 nafo_21B_gear_subset<-filter(nafo_21B_grouped_daysfished,Gear %in% c(8,9,10,11,12,13,14,15,51,41,49,50))
 

# Define gear groups and calculate effort
nafo_21B_effort_by_gear <- nafo_21B_gear_subset |>
  mutate(
    # Convert Tonnage to Gross Tonnage (GT)
    GT = case_when(
      Tonnage %in% c(1, 2) ~ (0 + 49.9) / 2,
      Tonnage == 3 ~ (50 + 149.9) / 2,
      Tonnage == 4 ~ (150 + 499.9) / 2,
      Tonnage == 5 ~ (500 + 999.9) / 2,
      Tonnage == 6 ~ (1000 + 1999.9) / 2,
      Tonnage == 7 ~ (2000 + 5000) / 2,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    # Calculate power and effort
    Power_kW = 11.26 * GT^0.71,
    Effort_kW_Days_yr = Power_kW * TotalDaysFished,
    # Define gear groups
    Gear_Group = case_when(
      Gear %in% c(8, 10, 11, 12, 16) ~ "Bottom Trawl",
      Gear %in% c(9, 13, 14, 15, 17) ~ "Midwater Trawl",
      #Gear %in% c(18, 19, 192) ~ "Other Trawl",
      Gear %in% c(41, 42) ~ "Gillnet",
      Gear == 51 ~ "Purse Seine",
      Gear %in% c(49, 50) ~ "Longline",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(Year, Gear_Group) |>
  summarise(Effort_kW_Days_yr = sum(Effort_kW_Days_yr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(Year >= 1978)

# Plot by gear group
ggplot(nafo_21B_effort_by_gear, aes(x = Year, y = Effort_kW_Days_yr, fill = Gear_Group)) +
  geom_area() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1992.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Fishing Effort by Gear Type (1960-2013)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Effort (kW-Days/year)",
    fill = "Gear Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Effort calculations:
### Need to convert Tonnage to Power (kW) by Gear type (FAO guidelines)
### Then multiply Power by Days Fished to get kW days per yr
### Anticamara et al 2011: 
###Power (kW) = 0.436 x (Length^2.021); R2 = 0.9; P < 0.0001
###Power (kW) = 11.26 x (Gross Tonnage^0.71)
#1. Calculate median of each length/tonnage category
#2. Calculate effort in kw*daysfished 


nafo_21B_subset$GT<-nafo_21B_subset$Power_kW<-NA
#code 1 or 2
nafo_21B_subset$GT[nafo_21B_subset$Tonnage %in% c(1,2)]<-(0+49.9)/2	
nafo_21B_subset$GT[nafo_21B_subset$Tonnage ==3]<-(50+149.9)/2
nafo_21B_subset$GT[nafo_21B_subset$Tonnage ==4]<-(150+499.9)/2	
nafo_21B_subset$GT[nafo_21B_subset$Tonnage ==5]<-(500+999.9)/2	
nafo_21B_subset$GT[nafo_21B_subset$Tonnage ==6]<-(1000+1999.9)/2	
nafo_21B_subset$GT[nafo_21B_subset$Tonnage ==7]<-(2000 +5000)/2
nafo_21B_subset$Power_kW<-11.26*nafo_21B_subset$GT^0.71

nafo_21B_subset$Effort_kW_Days_yr<-nafo_21B_subset$Power_kW*nafo_21B_subset$TotalDaysFished


nafo_21B_effort_by_species <- nafo_21B_subset %>% 
  group_by(Year, MainSpecies) %>%
  reframe(Effort_kW_Days_yr = sum(Effort_kW_Days_yr))

  labs(

    x = "Year",
    y = "Effort (kW-Days/year)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

ALLOCATE EFFORT TO SPECIES BASED ON PROPORTIONS OF CATCH (avoids need for interpolation of missing years in effort data, but assumes proportionality of catch and effort across species, which is a strong assumption but may be reasonable given the multispecies nature of the fishery and lack of species-specific effort data)
```{r}
# Create final effort matrix for mizer input
# Step 1: Get catch proportions by species and year (1978-2021)
catch_proportions <- stat_grouped |>
  filter(between(Year, 1978, 2024)) |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  mutate(
    Total_Catch_yr = sum(Catches_g_per_yr, na.rm = TRUE),
    Catch_Proportion = Catches_g_per_yr / Total_Catch_yr
  ) |>
  select(Year, Species, Catch_Proportion) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Species, values_from = Catch_Proportion, values_fill = 0)

# Step 2: Get total gear effort by year (1978-2021)
total_effort_by_year <- nafo_21B_effort_by_gear |>
  filter(between(Year, 1978, 2024)) |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  summarise(Total_Effort_kW_Days = sum(Effort_kW_Days_yr), .groups = "drop")

# Step 3: Allocate gear effort to species based on catch proportions
effort_by_species_allocated <- catch_proportions |>
  left_join(total_effort_by_year, by = "Year") |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(Year, Total_Effort_kW_Days), 
               names_to = "Species", values_to = "Catch_Prop") |>
  mutate(Effort_Allocated = Total_Effort_kW_Days * Catch_Prop) |>
  select(Year, Species, Effort_Allocated)

# Step 4: Create effort matrix (40 years × 15 species)
effort_matrix_mizer <- effort_by_species_allocated |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Species, values_from = Effort_Allocated, values_fill = 0) |>
  arrange(Year) |>
  column_to_rownames("Year") |>
  as.matrix()

# Step 5: Verify dimensions and save
dim(effort_matrix_mizer)  # Should be 40 × 15
colnames(effort_matrix_mizer)  # Check species names

# Standardize effort (0-1 scale for mizer)
effort_matrix_mizer_scaled <- effort_matrix_mizer |>
  apply(2, function(x) x / max(x, na.rm = TRUE))

# Save for mizer input
saveRDS(effort_matrix_mizer, file = "Ess_data/effort_matrix_mizer.RDS")
saveRDS(effort_matrix_mizer_scaled, file = "Ess_data/effort_matrix_mizer_scaled.RDS")
write.csv(effort_matrix_mizer, file = "Ess_data/effort_matrix_mizer.csv")
write.csv(effort_matrix_mizer_scaled, file = "Ess_data/effort_matrix_mizer_scaled.csv")

# Final plot showing effort allocation by species
ggplot(effort_by_species_allocated, aes(x = Year, y = Effort_Allocated, fill = Species)) +
  geom_area() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1992.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Fishing Effort Allocated to Species (1978-2017)",
    subtitle = "Effort allocation based on catch proportions | Red line = moratorium (1992)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Effort (kW-Days/year)",
    fill = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


# Add SANDLANCES as zero (no catch, no effort)
effort_matrix_mizer_scaled <- cbind(effort_matrix_mizer_scaled, SANDLANCES = 0)

# Re-order to 15 species
effort_matrix_mizer_scaled <- effort_matrix_mizer_scaled[, c(
  "AMERICAN PLAICE", "ATLANTIC COD", "ATLANTIC HALIBUT", "ATLANTIC HERRING",
  "ATLANTIC MACKEREL", "ATLANTIC REDFISHES", "CAPELIN", "HADDOCK", "POLLOCK",
  "SANDLANCES", "SILVER HAKE", "SPINY DOGFISH", "WHITE HAKE", "WITCH FLOUNDER",
  "YELLOWTAIL FLOUNDER"
)]

# Convert effort_matrix_mizer_scaled to long format for line plot
effort_mizer_long <- as.data.frame(effort_matrix_mizer_scaled) |>
  rownames_to_column("Year") |>
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(Year)) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -Year, names_to = "Species", values_to = "Effort_Scaled")

# Line plot of effort by species
ggplot(effort_mizer_long, aes(x = Year, y = Effort_Scaled, color = Species)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1992.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Mizer Input: Scaled Fishing Effort by Species (1978-2024)",
    subtitle = "Effort normalized to 0-1 scale | Red dashed line = moratorium (1992)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Scaled Effort (0-1)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# Or with facets for clarity
ggplot(effort_mizer_long, aes(x = Year, y = Effort_Scaled)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1992.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~Species, ncol = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Mizer Input: Scaled Fishing Effort by Species (1978-2024)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Scaled Effort (0-1)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
# Add SANDLANCES as zero row (if you want it visible on plot)
sandlances_row <- tibble(
  Year = 1978:2017,
  Species = "SANDLANCES",
  Effort_Allocated = 0,
  Catches = NA,
  Effort_Scaled = 0,
  Catch_Scaled = NA
)

effort_mizer_long_with_catch_with_sandlances <- 
  bind_rows(effort_mizer_long_with_catch, sandlances_row)

# Plot with SANDLANCES (shows as flat zero line)
ggplot(effort_mizer_long_with_catch_with_sandlances, aes(x = Year)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Effort_Scaled, color = "Effort"), linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_line(aes(y = Catch_Scaled, color = "Catch"), linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1992.5, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~Species, ncol = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Mizer Input: Scaled Effort vs. Catches by Species (1978-2021)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Scaled (0-1)",
    color = "Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
